{{Video Games}}

This is a list of [[personal computer games]] ([[video game]]s for [[personal computers]], including those running [[Windows]], [[macOS]], and [[Linux]]) that have sold or shipped at least one million copies. If a game was released on multiple platforms, the sales figures list are only for PC sales. This list is ''not'' comprehensive because sales figures are not always publicly available.

Subscription figures for [[massively multiplayer online game]]s such as ''[[Microsoft Flight Simulator|Flight Simulator]]'' or ''[[Lineage (video game)|Lineage]]'' and number of accounts from [[free-to-play]] games such as ''[[Hearthstone (video game)|Hearthstone]]''<!--Furthermore, any citation should state strictly PC sales --> are not taken into account as they do not necessarily correspond to sales.
